text: Provider prompt caching may reduce latency and billed input cost but cached tokens remain part of total input/context accounting; context reduction requires omitting repeated text.
Place byte-stable universal policy before an explicit cache boundary when the host permits it; place prompt-, state-, and identity-dependent blocks afterward.
Deliver invariant policy once per context epoch, advisor and Gate relays only on relevant semantic transitions, and continuity/goal on lifecycle or mutation events.
